principles: The verification gate is the ONLY path to receiptVerified=true; local append never sets it
Pluggable injected verifier keeps usage-ledger decoupled (no authority-signing import)
Envelope is digest-only + non-secret (reuse the privacy denylist); never raw content
A referenced receipt without genuine verification stays receiptVerified=false
Negative controls are load-bearing: prove the gate cannot be tricked
drivers: Freeze the evidence-envelope contract + anti-overclaim gate so a future server path plugs in cleanly
Spec forbids local overclaiming — receiptVerified must stay false until genuine verification
Keep the ledger module decoupled (zero cross-module imports)

options.name: A: in-module authority-evidence.ts (envelope + pluggable gate) + record fields
pros: Contract frozen for the future server
cons: Local effect is contract + gate, not a verified receipt (by design)

options.name: B: import authority-signing.ts into usage-ledger and verify locally
cons: Couples the ledger to the authority subsystem (breaks zero-cross-module-imports); no server/receipts locally anyway — rejected

chosen: A: in-module authority-evidence.ts (envelope + pluggable gate) + record fields
rationale: A pluggable injected verifier freezes the envelope + verification contract and the anti-overclaim gate while keeping usage-ledger decoupled; locally everything stays receiptVerified=false (correct per spec), and the negative controls prove the gate cannot be tricked into a false authority claim.

preMortem.scenario: The gate is tricked into receiptVerified=true without genuine verification
preMortem.trigger: Accepting transport-ok / token presence / hash / copied id as proof
preMortem.mitigation: verified ONLY via injected verifier returning true + subject match; 4 negative controls (transport, tokens, hash, copied id) each assert receiptVerified stays false

preMortem.scenario: Envelope leaks raw content or a secret
preMortem.mitigation: Envelope = recordDigest + an explicit allowlist of non-secret fields; reuse the privacy denylist; smoke asserts zero forbidden material
Verifier is injected; module imports only ./ siblings + node; smoke asserts zero cross-module imports

preMortem.scenario: Local append path accidentally sets receiptVerified=true
preMortem.mitigation: Append/builders keep receiptVerified=false; validator rejects local receiptVerified!=false; only the gate can flip it; tested

preMortem.scenario: A receipt reference is treated as verification
preMortem.mitigation: receiptId/subject present without verifier confirmation stays receiptVerified=false; distinct negative control
